I fixed both enlarged-text defects in CSS, but none of it is measured yet. I didn't run the proof command: you asked me not to call shell commands this round, and my calls were denied last round. I also haven't rendered anything.

**Files changed** (both in `design/prototypes/lsatu-dashboard/new-versions/11-claude-studio/`):
- `style.css`
- `README.md`

`app.js` and `index.html` are untouched, so your earlier syntax pass still applies to `app.js`.

**1. Home tools overflowing at 200% text**
- `.head-tools` now has one contained column track (`minmax(0,1fr)`).
- The finder label can wrap; it was previously held on one line.
- Quick actions are now a wrapping row. Each control keeps its natural width and moves whole to the next line when the row is full. A label wraps inside its control only if a single control is wider than the column.
- I removed the fixed two-column phone grid for quick actions.
- Nothing is hidden, clipped or shrunk.

**2. Statement cells squeezing their numbers**
- The fixed 12 columns are replaced with `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(1.75em, 1fr))`. The minimum width is set by the size of the numbers, and cell height is now relative to them too.
- At normal text size, all 12 cells should still sit on one row. At enlarged text, 1–12 wraps onto more rows in reading order.
- The five done cells and the outlined statement 6 keep their styling. The dark resume card and the light Progress card use the same rule.
- The phone breakpoints now change the track's text size instead of setting fixed pixel heights.

**Watch in your recapture:** at 320px with normal text, the cells may wrap to 11 + 1 if my width estimate is off. I narrowed the gap at that width to avoid it, but I haven't measured it.

**Deviations:** none. The design is otherwise unchanged, and the README has a dated "Fix round 1" section plus an updated verification list.

**Still for you to run:** the `node --check` proof, and the 200% text captures at 390px and 320px.
